guard: space create prepares a space only for a free name and a free root that is not the home folder, makes its .cotal, and every reader lists, shows, selects or refuses it as prepared; up starts it only in its root and drops the prepared record; forget removes it
command: pnpm --filter cotal-ai... build && pnpm exec tsx implementations/cli/smoke/space-registration.smoke.ts
why: Each mutation removes one check space create makes before it writes, one place a reader recognises a prepared space, or one step up takes when it starts one, or reports one of up's refusals as unknown. The suite drives the built binary, so each mutation rebuilds it and the restore rebuilds it back.

mutations.cell: a registered name is CONFLICT

mutations.cell: a prepared name is CONFLICT, exit 2, naming its root
